product_metadata.title: 23 Slot Clear Knife Block Without Knives,Kitchen Knife Holder Organizer Stand Durable Bamboo Knife Dock Rack with Transparent Tempered Glass.
features: Easy to assemble: The knife holder is very easy to assemble, the whole operation takes only 5-8 minutes. We provide instructions and installation videos to make sure you can assemble it correctly.

Ergonomic and durable: Knife Block is designed with an inclined angle to make it easier to grasp the knives habitually. Knife Block is sturdy enough to hold heavy knife sets, greatly helping your kitchen stay organized and ready for cooking delicious food.

Tempered glass:Added to its versatility, this fantastic bamboo block is placed between two tempered glass sheets with an attractive curve. Your knives are at the perfect angle for both display and use, with an open bottom that allows moisture and dust to fall away naturally.

Stable & Non Slip: The semi-enclosed design of the kitchen knife holder creates a sense of security through two pieces of transparent tempered glass. These glasses are 6mm thick, resistant to high temperatures and scratches. At the bottom of the glass, there are two non-slip strips to prevent slippage.The knife rack is made of bamboo with grain and texture.

Save Space :There are 23 Slots for knives of various sizes, including 2 slot for chopping knife, 1 slot for slicing knife, 10 dinner knife slots, 8 chef's knife slots,,2 slots for kitchen scissors, 1 slot for knife sharpener. The knife holder allows you to save a lot of space and store all of your knives in an organized way.
